name: Routine work leaves a calm Boop calm
case: With the chatter personality, so every tool call reaches Boop, two quick turns go by: commands that pass, a plain request and a matter-of-fact finish each. Boop may react to everything, but none of it is a reason to leave calm: its mood holds all through, with no bouncing.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: never change the mood for a routine turn alone; characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: calm stays through routine turns and plain finishes. Staying is the mood question's first option, and no change is fine (MoodOutput.options)

steps.message: Renamed the config loader in 3 files.
Tidied the imports; the build passes.
